changelog:
- Initial release of local semantic memory search for OpenClaw using Ollama and nomic-embed-text.
- Enables free, private, and offline memory search with no API key required.
- Provides setup instructions for FreeBSD and other OSes.
- Replaces cloud-based embedding APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Gemini) with a locally-running model.
- Includes troubleshooting and advanced configuration references.
